text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D at a loss and later selling Stock B below cost reminded me not to hold or exit a position just to avoid the pain of realizing a loss; reassess its prospects objectively.","My repeated trades in Stock B show that activity is not the same as good judgment; before trading, I should identify a clear reason and compare it with the costs of changing my position.","I should manage the portfolio as a whole, balancing risk and diversification rather than letting the satisfaction of gains or the discomfort of losses in individual stocks dominate my decisions."]}
